headline: The connection was instant. So why won't he commit?
note:
CONNECTION-VOCAB family (2026-08-27). NEW angle `commitment-connection` — one angle per keyword, per the soulmate-keyword convention.

THE FEAR: did I invent what that meant. Cut 3 affirms the speed was real without ruling on him.

🔴 The corpus uses "connection" for men not seen in twenty years, so the read may NOT presume ongoing contact or a recent meeting.
⚠ One buyer's own verdict is "he uses women" — the read does not adopt it.

VOC: fb-tarot/docs/drafts/rewrites/_voc-commit-vocab-2026-08-27.md

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were face down, and your hand went to the one who draws things to him.
Look at the flowers at his feet. They came up right where he stands.
You said the connection was instant. What catches me is that the ground answered him at once.
And yet nothing has been promised. The speed was on your side of it.
Something reaches this just as it would be spoken. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what reaches it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see the cards, and you chose the one with a single tie on him.
One rope, one ankle. Everything else on him hangs loose.
You told me it was instant. This card puts one fixed thing in front of me.
Still, nothing has moved since. And the promise hasn't come.
There's something between the feeling and the word for it. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's in that gap…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs looked identical, and your hand found the one out in full daylight.
Look at the sun behind him. It's full, and nothing on the card is in shadow.
You said it was instant, dear. This card brings me to a moment with nothing hidden in it.
But nothing was ever said out loud. And you're wondering what that speed meant.
What holds this back holds it out of sight. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind it…
